title: S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.16937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Typed System-1 (S1) decision models are increasingly deployed in LLM agents for routing, moderation, and authorization to cut inference cost, yet untrusted context can still manipulate typed outputs and alter execution branches. Unlike autoregressive System-2 (S2) models, S1 interfaces score dynamic rules and options without token-by-token decoding, mismatching attacks targeting text continuation or explicit override commands. We propose S1-Evo, a self-evolving framework tailored to S1's contract-based option competition and margin feedback. S1-Evo perturbs untrusted fields via contract-aware evidence channels to induce \emph{evidence competition} with original task evidence while preserving fact invariance. Offline on seed tasks, it optimizes candidates via feedback search guided by directional margins and re-verification, distilling verified flips into experience cards. At test time, S1-Evo retrieves relevant cards to construct perturb

translated_title: S1-Evo：针对类型化系统-1决策模型的经验引导式证据竞争攻击
translated_abstract: 类型化系统-1（S1）决策模型越来越多地被部署在LLM智能体中，用于路由、内容审核和授权，以降低推理成本，然而不可信的上下文仍然可以操纵其类型化输出并改变执行分支。与自回归的系统-2（S2）模型不同，S1接口对动态规则和选项进行打分，无需逐token解码，因此针对文本续写或显式覆盖指令设计的攻击方法与之并不匹配。我们提出S1-Evo，一个专为S1基于契约的选项竞争与边界反馈机制量身定制的自进化攻击框架。S1-Evo通过契约感知的证据通道对不可信字段进行扰动，在保持事实不变性的同时，诱发这些扰动证据与原始任务证据之间的“证据竞争”。在种子任务上进行离线优化时，它通过由方向性边界与重验证引导的反馈搜索来优化候选扰动，并将验证成功的翻转案例提炼为经验卡。在测试阶段，S1-Evo检索相关经验卡来构建扰动……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出S1-Evo自进化攻击框架，通过契约感知的证据扰动诱发证据竞争，并借助经验卡机制指导测试时扰动构建，从而在保持事实不变性的前提下有效攻击LLM智能体中部署的类型化系统-1决策模型。
